title: Pan-Seared Cod With Slovakian Crust
description: A crispy Slovakian crust adds a unique flavor to this pan-seared cod dish. Serve with a side of wholesome stir-fry.

ingredients.name: Slovakian flour
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of wheat and rye flours

instructions: 2. Season cod fillets with salt and set aside.
3. In a shallow dish, mix together Slovakian flour, crispy breadcrumbs, and a pinch of salt.
4. Dip each cod fillet in the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
5. Heat wholesome oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Add the coated cod fillets to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
7. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
8. While the cod is baking, prepare the wholesome stir-fry by heating a little oil in a separate pan.
9. Add your favorite stir-fry ingredients (not included in this recipe) and cook until tender.
10. Serve the pan-seared cod with the wholesome stir-fry and enjoy!
